description: Cane fruit of cool climates, grown in India only on a small scale in the hills. It needs well-drained, slightly acidic soil and mild summers.
npk_split: Apply compost with all P and K before growth starts in spring and the N in two splits, at bud break and after fruit set; adjust by soil test.

healthy.name: Healthy
healthy.description: The leaf shows no sign of disease, pest or deficiency. Keep the rows open and remove old fruited canes after harvest to keep it that way.
symptoms: Uniform green leaves without spots or rust-coloured powder
healthy.spread: Not applicable - no disease or pest detected.
healthy.action: Continue regular cane pruning, mulching, balanced nutrition and weekly scouting.
